हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/9X9s6B
show.description: A once-wealthy heir, Shivin, abandons his empire to prove his love, living as a humble delivery boy. But when his wife Kiara prioritizes status, wealth, and another man over their relationship even in moments of life and death, his world shatters. Betrayed, humiliated, and broken, Shivin rises from rock bottom to reclaim his identity, power, and self-respect, setting the stage for love, revenge, and redemption.
